d:
Kekre ko pyar ki talash thi. samandar vishal tha. tab kaise mile koee sathi, jab na koee tirri ki suvidha, na kaib buking ka koee andar vatar aip.
To jab-jab is duniya men muhabbat ko tezi ki zarurat hoti hai to kahin se aata hai ek... kachhuaa. phir kachhue ki pith par shuru hoti hai ek chhoti si lav stori...
Bharat men SONY BBC Earth par Planet Earth III aur aise hi dilchasp sho dekhen.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
